Package hadur2.core.move

Class ProteanPick

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.move.ProteanPick
public final class ProteanPick extends Object
MOVE-14: the protean pick. Among the surf's options it draws one at random, with a softmin over their dangers, so a gun that has learned our least-danger option is right less often, and the cost in danger is bounded: the Gibbs distribution's expected excess over the best option is at most T ln K, with T the temperature. An option much worse than the best is never drawn (the safety cap).

The die. The logistic map x -> 4x(1 - x) is chaotic, and u = (2 / pi) asin(sqrt(x)) makes its values uniform on [0, 1]. The enemy never sees x, so to it the draws are fair; to us they replay exactly from the seed (seed(java.lang.String, int)), which keeps the replay fixtures deterministic and the core free of java.util.Random. In floating point the orbit can fall into 0, the fixed point 3/4 or a short cycle: a state at one of those, or equal to any of the last 64 states, is moved on by the golden ratio's fraction.

Pure: no engine types, no clock. The surf feeds it the option dangers, the views' spread per option and their mean danger; the order of options is the caller's.
